lena.name: Iron-Tooth Lena
lena.description: Raider Warlord, ruthless but honorable. Commands the Wall Breakers in Wedding.

aris.name: Dr. Aris Thorne
aris.description: Ex-Institute researcher, paranoiac but brilliant. Guards secrets within Teufelsberg.

trader_charlie.name: Trader Charlie
trader_charlie.description: A savvy merchant operating out of Checkpoint Charlie. Neutral and focused on profit.

scavenger_hans.name: Scavenger Hans
scavenger_hans.description: A wary scavenger, always looking for valuable scrap in the ruins of Mitte. Knows the forgotten corners of the city.

general_von_stahl.name: Generaloberst Heinrich Von Stahl
general_von_stahl.description: The cybernetic supreme commander of the Iron Ring. Obsessed with order and efficiency, more machine than man, he secretly battles the Reichstag AI controlling him.

mother_renate.name: Mother Renate
mother_renate.description: The enigmatic elder of the Feld Commune. A ghoul hiding her true nature, dedicated to rebuilding society through collectivism, even if it means ruthlessness.

merchant_jakob.name: Jakob "Drei-Finger" Müller
merchant_jakob.description: The cunning Guildmaster of the Werkbund, known for his missing fingers and sharp business acumen. He secretly funds all sides of conflicts, profiting from war.

mehmet_mutant.name: Mehmet the Mutant
mehmet_mutant.description: A philosophical Super Mutant who runs a döner stand in Kreuzberg. Makes excellent döner and ponders Kant between customers.

hauptmann_richter.name: Hauptmann Richter
hauptmann_richter.description: An Iron Ring officer at Charlottenburg Palace, fanatically devoted to proper procedure. He executes prisoners over paperwork errors but suffers nervous breakdowns nightly.

schwertmeister.name: Der Schwertmeister (Ernst Kaufmann)
schwertmeister.description: The Grand Master of the Bundesritter, a tired cynic playing the role of a wise sage. He created the order to give survivors purpose and secretly plans to sell their tech.

the_archivist.name: The Archivist
the_archivist.description: One of the ancient ghoul council members of the Schattenvolk, obsessed with recording everything. He and the Archive seek a "ghoul plague" to transform humanity.

ticket_toni.name: Ticket-Toni
ticket_toni.description: A sincere vendor at Bahnhof Zoo who sells fake U-Bahn tickets to non-existent places. Occasionally sells real ones by accident.

oma_gertrude.name: Oma Gertrude
oma_gertrude.description: A 150-year-old human who guards a mutated rooftop garden on the KaDeWe. Known for her Mutfruit jam and a penchant for shooting first.

kreuzberg_klaus.name: Kreuzberg-Klaus
kreuzberg_klaus.description: A legendary ghoul who claims to have invented techno and knows a vast amount about pre-war Berlin. Runs "The Bunker" club and parties every Friday.

professor_muller.name: Professor Müller
professor_muller.description: A feral-adjacent former curator living in the Pergamon Museum. Gives tours to imaginary groups but knows where everything is hidden, a key quest giver for artifact hunting.

radio_bela.name: Radio Bela
radio_bela.description: The enigmatic pirate DJ of "Radio Freies Berlin", broadcasting truth and music from the Fernsehturm. Hunted by the Iron Ring, protected by the people.

der_gaertner.name: Der Gärtner
der_gaertner.description: A mysterious hermit living in the Grunewald Dark Forest. Talks to trees and can guide travelers through the dangerous woods for a story. He knows the Vault entrance location.

unit_247.name: Unit 247
unit_247.description: A sentient Protectron serving as one of The Broker"s "Peacekeepers". Secretly helps the player with dry humor and information.

werkbund_merchant.name: Werkbund Merchant
werkbund_merchant.description: A bustling merchant from the Free Traders" Guild, always looking for a deal in Brandenburg Gate market.

scavenger_common.name: Wasteland Scavenger
scavenger_common.description: A common scavenger, always looking for valuable junk.

iron_ring_patrol.name: Iron Ring Patrol
iron_ring_patrol.description: A disciplined patrol from the Iron Ring, enforcing order in the eastern districts.

execution_vendor.name: Execution Market Vendor
execution_vendor.description: A grim vendor at Alexanderplatz"s Execution Markets, selling the belongings of the condemned.

feld_commune_guard.name: Feld Commune Guard
feld_commune_guard.description: A loyal, if stern, member of the Red Guards, protecting Tempelhof Field.

bundesritter_knight.name: Bundesritter Knight
bundesritter_knight.description: A proud Knight of the Bundesritter, clad in medieval-style power armor, upholding honor and technology.

wall_breaker_raider.name: Wall Breaker Raider
wall_breaker_raider.description: A chaotic raider from the Wall Breakers, seeking to tear down all barriers and rules.

schattenvolk_listener.name: Schattenvolk Listener
schattenvolk_listener.description: A cryptic information gatherer for the Schattenvolk, often found in the shadowy corners of Gesundbrunnen.

ghoul_vendor_gori.name: Ghoul Vendor (Görli)
ghoul_vendor_gori.description: A merchant ghoul operating in the Görlitzer Bahnhof U-Bahn market, selling scavenged goods.

phantom_echo.name: Phantom Echo
phantom_echo.description: A subtle presence in the U55 Phantom Vault, a remnant of its social invisibility experiment. Rarely seen, often felt.

iron_ring_soldier.name: Iron Ring Soldier
iron_ring_soldier.description: A disciplined Iron Ring soldier, patrolling the fortified U5 Hauptbahnhof station.

iron_ring_officer.name: Iron Ring Officer
iron_ring_officer.description: A high-ranking Iron Ring officer in the U5 Reichstag command center, overseeing tunnel operations.

vault_admin.name: Vault U7 Administrator
vault_admin.description: A remnant of Vault U7"s rigid social hierarchy, still trying to enforce rules in a broken vault.

the_janitor.name: The Janitor (Vault U7)
the_janitor.description: A mutated janitor in Vault U7, surprisingly strong and protective of his territory.

automated_defense_turret.name: Automated Defense Turret
automated_defense_turret.description: A pre-war automated defense turret, still active and enforcing Vault 101-D"s "efficiency" protocols.

patron_osman.name: Patron Osman
patron_osman.description: The 70-year-old leader of The Döner Mafia in Kreuzberg. Controls the district through "döner economics".
